mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a pleasant temperature of 73 degrees at Verona Area High School. Under a Waning Gibbous moon, keep an eye out for the International Space Station tonight at 8:38 PM as it travels for three minutes from the West Southwest over Mount Horeb toward the South Southwest near Belleville.

The Verona Plan Commission is preparing for an October 5th meeting to review several projects, including certified survey maps for Country View Court and Spring Rose Road, as well as site plans for developments like Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

We have a busy schedule for our community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, and the downtown farmer's market returns on September 30th.

A notable report from the police department occurred on September 21st, when officers investigated a retail theft where an individual was identified and cited for stealing candy from a business on East Verona Avenue.

Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, which is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is open and serving until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
